formula: Fleet = (Hourly Demand * Trip Duration * Spatial Buffer) / (1 - Maintenance Share)
operational_takeaway: Under standard assumptions (30-min average trip, 1.5x spatial buffer, 10% maintenance), even a high-stress 95th-percentile hour (563 rentals/hr) requires only ~470 active bikes. A 2,000-bike fleet has a surplus of 1530 bikes on paper. Reported shortages are caused by spatial docking imbalance, not a fleet size deficit.
